ننضجع (form VII)
# نَنْضَجِعُ (nanḍajiʕu) /nan.dˤa.d͡ʒi.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْضَجَعَ (inḍajaʕa)
# نَنْضَجِعَ (nanḍajiʕa) /nan.dˤa.d͡ʒi.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْضَجَعَ (inḍajaʕa)
# نَنْضَجِعْ (nanḍajiʕ) /nan.dˤa.d͡ʒiʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْضَجَعَ (inḍajaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
